info.title: Risk Management
info.description: These APIs provide authorized systems/users access to the Global Dispute Platform (GDP), enabling them to search for disputes, provide document, and manage their lifecycle.

post.description: Use this endpoint to post messages to a dispute when the POST MESSAGE capability is allowed

parameters.name: disputeId
parameters.description: Dispute ID starting with 'dispute_' followed by 21 alpha-numeric characters.

parameters.name: Request-Reference
parameters.description: Optional Reference for the request. This is used to identify the request in debugging.

parameters.name: Request-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional Idempotency Key for the request. Sending duplicate requests will result in 409 HTTP status code.

201.description: Successfully posted the message for a dispute

409.description: Target event could not be reset due to a concurrent update.

post.description:
Upload a file to a dispute as `multipart/form-data` when the `UPLOAD_FILE` capability is allowed.

The `file` part must contain raw binary data (for example PDF or image bytes). Base64-encoded file content is not supported, including when indicated via `Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64`. Omit Content-Transfer-Encoding or use `binary`.

Set an appropriate Content-Type on the file part, such as `application/pdf` or `image/png`.

parameters.name: disputeId
parameters.description: Dispute ID starting with 'dispute_' followed by 21 alpha-numeric characters.

parameters.name: Request-Reference
parameters.description: Optional Reference for the request. This is used to identify the request in debugging.

parameters.name: Request-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional Idempotency Key for the request. Sending duplicate requests will result in 409 HTTP status code.

201.description: Successfully uploaded the file and linked to a dispute

Location.description: URI of the uploaded file resource

409.description: Target event could not be reset due to a concurrent update.

post.description: Use this endpoint to perform actions like accept, challenge or offer on a dispute

parameters.name: disputeId
parameters.description: Dispute ID starting with 'dispute_' followed by 21 alpha-numeric characters.

parameters.name: Request-Reference
parameters.description: Optional Reference for the request. This is used to identify the request in debugging.

parameters.name: Request-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional Idempotency Key for the request. Sending duplicate requests will result in 409 HTTP status code.

202.description: Success with status as ACCEPT_PROCESSING, CHALLENGE_PROCESSING or OFFER_PROCESSING depending on the action

409.description: Target event could not be reset due to a concurrent update.

get.description:
Endpoint to fetch information of all the disputes corresponding to a PPRO Payment Charge ID.
Only authenticated users can call this endpoint via Global API (GAPI).

parameters.name: paymentChargeId
parameters.description: Payment Charge starting with 'charge_' followed by 21 characters.

parameters.name: Request-Reference
parameters.description: Optional Reference for the request. This is used to identify the request in debugging.

409.description: Target event could not be reset due to a concurrent update.

get.description: Use this endpoint to download file linked to a dispute. Returns the file as a binary stream.

parameters.name: disputeId
parameters.description: Dispute ID starting with 'dispute_' followed by 21 alpha-numeric characters.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: File ID starting with 'file_' followed by 21 alpha-numeric characters.

parameters.name: Request-Reference
parameters.description: Optional Reference for the request. This is used to identify the request in debugging.

200.description: File downloaded successfully. The response body contains the raw file data as a binary stream.

Content-Disposition.description: Indicates how the content should be displayed

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the file

409.description: Target event could not be reset due to a concurrent update.

get.description: Use this endpoint to fetch information from a single dispute, based on a Dispute ID

parameters.name: disputeId
parameters.description: Dispute ID starting with 'dispute_' followed by 21 alpha-numeric characters.

parameters.name: Request-Reference
parameters.description: Optional Reference for the request. This is used to identify the request in debugging.

409.description: Target event could not be reset due to a concurrent update.

providerPaymentChargeReference.description: Payment charge reference from the provider.

merchantPaymentChargeReference.description: Payment charge reference from the merchant.

content.example: I have attached the requested documentation
We have reviewed your claim and require additional documentation

phase.description: Phase of the dispute when message was created

createdAt.description: Date and time when the message was created

PreSignedUploadRequest.description: Request to generate a one-time pre-signed upload URL

checksum.description: Base64-encoded MD5 checksum of the file content

contentLength.description: Exact file size in bytes; the upload body must match this length

name.description: Original filename to use when downloading the file. Deprecated alias: `fileName`.

contentType.description: MIME type of the file; the upload must include the same Content-Type header

FileResponse.description: File resource response with HATEOAS links

id.description: The unique file identifier starting with file_.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the file was created.

phase.description: Phase when the file was added.

UploadFileRequest.description: Request to upload a file to a dispute

file.description: The file to upload as a multipart form part with name 'file'

eventType.description: Expected type of the target queue event.

additionalAttempts.description: Additional maxAttempts to grant on reset. Defaults to 1.

value.description: The monetary value to be charged or processed, expressed in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for EUR).

currency.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the amount is denominated.

type.description: Action that can be performed on the dispute

resolution.description: The resolution chosen by the merchant for this action. Required if defined in the config for certain action types.

message.description: Message text. Required if defined in the config for certain action types.
message.example: We offer a partial refund of $80 for this transaction.

amount.description: Amount to be used for the action. Required if defined in the config for certain action types.

dueByInDays.description: Number of days by when this action is due. Deprecated: use dueBy instead.

resolutions.description: The resolution options available for the action. If none are specified, no resolution options are required.

AcceptActionDto.description: Defines parameters for the ACCEPT action, used when the merchant chooses to accept a dispute.
AcceptActionDto.title: Action Config Dto (ACCEPT)

dueBy.description: Date and time by which this action must be completed.

messageConfig.description: Message requirements. If not provided, messaging will be disabled for this action.

statusAllowedIn.description: The status in which this capability is allowed

dueByInDays.description: Number of days by when this action is due. Deprecated: use dueBy instead.

filesRequired.description: Are files required for the challenge? if yes, file upload capability config should also be provided.

amountRequired.description: Is the amount required for the challenge. If not specified, the full disputed amount will be challenged.

CreateDisputeRequest.description: Create Dispute Request. The attempt to create a dispute for an existing providerDisputeReference will be ignored and recorded by GDP. At least one of the following fields must be provided: providerPaymentChargeReference, merchantPaymentChargeReference, paymentChargeId

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of the currency (e.g., cents for USD) and currency is in ISO 4217 format.

openingNote.description: A note provided when opening the dispute by the consumer.

openedAt.description: Timestamp when the dispute was opened by the consumer, in ISO 8601 UTC datetime format.

receivedAt.description: Timestamp when the dispute was received in PPRO, in ISO 8601 UTC datetime format.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for the payment. Eg., CARD

providerName.description: Name of the provider handling the dispute. Eg., BBVA

processorName.description: Name of the processor handling the payment/dispute. Eg., CARD_PROCESSOR

config.description: Configuration details specific to the provider.

providerPaymentChargeReference.description: Provider payment reference. At least one of providerPaymentChargeReference, merchantPaymentChargeReference, paymentOperationNumber or paymentChargeId must be provided.

merchantPaymentChargeReference.description: Merchant payment reference. At least one of providerPaymentChargeReference, merchantPaymentChargeReference, paymentOperationNumber or paymentChargeId must be provided.

paymentOperationNumber.description: PPRO Payment Feature Number. At least one of providerPaymentChargeReference, merchantPaymentChargeReference, paymentOperationNumber or paymentChargeId must be provided.

name.description: Name of the file. Deprecated alias: `fileName`.

maxFileSizeInMb.description: Maximum individual file size allowed (in Mb)

dueByInDays.description: Number of days by when this action is due. Deprecated: use dueBy instead.

OfferActionDto.description: Defines parameters for the OFFER action, used when the merchant chooses to make an offer on a dispute.
OfferActionDto.title: Action Config Dto (OFFER)

maxLength.description: Maximum length of the message content

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of the currency (e.g., cents for USD) and currency is in ISO 4217 format.
